## Checks

- [ ] One change per pull request, branched from `main`.
- [ ] A behaviour fix has a guard test that fails without it, and a `docs/history/FIXLOG.md` entry.
- [ ] `tools/ci.sh` passes (fmt, clippy, tests, generated docs).
- [ ] Nothing private is added: no real names, email addresses, IP addresses, hostnames, home-directory paths, tokens or private links. Use placeholders such as `user@example.com` and `192.0.2.1`.
- [ ] Nothing here depends on a language model at run time.
